gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a ~1,500 Wh kit with 200 W of panels ships now for $759.24: the ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SE200 (1,451 Wh) through our link, which is $0.52 per Wh. ChatGPT's pick, the Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 + 2×100 W Air, is $1,279 at Wellbots ($0.83 per Wh), so the ALLPOWERS kit is $519.76 cheaper, but it uses ternary lithium cells and Jackery uses LiFePO4.
standout_why: I compared against powersized.com/solar-generator-kits (cited, read 2026-11-17) and stormwatts.com (cited, data as of 2026-11-08). In the 1,200–1,800 Wh range, powersized lists only three Jackery kits at 1,536 Wh ($1,399, $1,439 and $1,849). Stormwatts lists only the Jackery 1000 Plus + 2×100 W Air (1,264 Wh, $869). Neither lists an ALLPOWERS kit, and neither shows that no EcoFlow DELTA kit falls in this range. I could not open our own page, dealectric.com/solar-generator-with-panels-included, because of a TLS certificate error, so I could not check it.
decides: This changes the price pick. Within ±20% of 1,500 Wh, the cheapest kit that ships now with 200 W of panels is the ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SE200 at $759.24 (link price). The cheapest with 400 W is the S2000 Pro + SP037 at $917.93, but that code has not yet been cart-tested on that kit. Both cost hundreds less than any Jackery 1,536 Wh kit. The Jackery 1500 v2 kit ($1,279 at Wellbots, listed as available) stays the pick for a shopper who wants LiFePO4 cells, and our kit honestly wins the budget segment. The S2000 + SF200 (1,500 Wh, $612.90) is the cheaper option for a shopper who can wait for the Nov 20 dispatch. BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kits (2,073.6 Wh, +38%) and AC180 kits (1,152 Wh, −23%) fall outside the size line.
